Name: Adopt Leo (1.6 Version)
Author: Murrthecat
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=5]This Mod is No Longer Being Maintained[/size][/color]

Sorry to the people who like this mod, but I am simply not skilled enough to resolve the complex issues that this mod creates. If anyone wants to update it and upload it as their own mod, please do so.

xxx

In order for this mod to work, you need Content Patcher, Smapi (of course), and Hugs and Kisses continued. Because he is a roommate, if you want to marry someone or have another roommate, you will need a polyamory mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url]. I have switched over to using PolyamorySweet and do not know if Free Love still works.

I have still been playing through the 1.6 update and have not gotten the chance to adopt Leo myself, so I don't know if the mod works as intended. Let me know if you have issues, and I will work to resolve them. In the future, I intend to release a more expansive dialogue update, but that is still a ways away, as I am working on a different mod right now.

For Hugs and Kisses continued, put

"CustomKissFrames": "Leo:24",

in the config of Hugs and Kisses continued. This should allow Leo to use one of his sprites for a hugging animation.

Thank you to 7thAxis of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Lurking in the Dark[/url] fame for allowing me to look at their roommate code. Thank you again to Elhrvy, author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna[/url], for kindly fixing my code to make it work and FellowClown, author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20295]A New Dream[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22600]Passerby Cemetery[/url], for making a beautiful custom room and patio for Leo.

[color=#ff0000]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color]

Older description:

This mod allows you to adopt Leo after reaching 10 hearts with him. You must buy the Second Key from Pierre and give it to Leo. Basically it just turns him into a roommate like Krobus. Adds dialogue that emphasizes the parent-son relationship between the player and Leo, as well as his relationship with Jas, Vincent, Linus, and Willy. Originally I made this mod for personal use, so there are probably many problems. For example, Leo does not have a hugging animation. I am not good at modding, so I will be upfront that I have no intention of maintaining this mod. I only got the mod running at all because of the kindness of people like elhrvy and the members of the Stardew discord. Please feel free to edit things in the mod if you want.

If you want to marry someone or bring in another roommate, you'll need Free Love installed.

Elhrvy, maker of the super-cool [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606]Juna[/url] mod, fixed my mod so that the dialogue actually shows up in game. They also helped me with Leo's schedule, and the entirety of the mod is based off their roommate mod. FellowClown, maker of such incredible mods as the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4499]Wayfarer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4500]John[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4882]Nikolai[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5653]Magical Family[/url], made the pretty "Spouse" room and patio for Leo. Thank you again for all your help!

If anyone can figure out a way to make him spawn outside his room at the beginning of the day more, please let me know.

Downloads.Description: This is an updated version of Adopt Leo to work with 1.6. I haven't had a chance to test it in game yet, but I know it's been an issue for some people. Look at the updated Description for details and plans for further updates.
